name: Fixture
long_description: Fixture is a CRM for startups that helps you find your next customers and keep deals moving. It brings your customer emails, meetings, and conversations together, so you don’t have to keep your CRM up to date by hand. Fixture agents suggest prospects similar to customers you’ve won and helps you follow up on active deals. Use it in your browser or from agents like ChatGPT and Claude.
one_liner: An agentic CRM built for Startups
